messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D first-person dirt-box sandbox with an admin-only panel and effectively endless configuration options.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions and finish the game without clarification.
- Include 3D, first-person gameplay, an admin panel, and extensible configurations.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a standalone `index.html` using Three.js from a CDN.
- Interpreted “only admin panel” as creator/admin controls for building and changing world settings.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a playable sandbox with a dirt/grass starting area, first-person movement, jump, mouse-look, object placement/removal, and mobile touch controls.
- Added admin Build, World, and Configs tabs; configurable objects, world controls, local save/load, and configuration export.
- Verified the embedded JavaScript passes `node --check`.
- Opened the app in Playwright and saved/inspected a viewport screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/dirtbox.jpg`.

### Active
- No active work recorded.

### Blocked
- Browser console has a missing favicon 404; this does not block the game.

## Next Move
1. Optionally add a favicon or suppress the missing favicon request.
2. Run any further gameplay checks and inspect git status before wrapping up.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation and UI.

## Important Context
- Development server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Work is uncommitted; no commit or push was made.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D first-person dirt-box sandbox with an admin-only panel and extensible configurations.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions and finish the game without clarification.
- Include 3D, first-person gameplay, an admin panel, and extensible configurations.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a standalone `index.html` using Three.js from a CDN.
- Interpreted the admin panel as creator controls for building and changing world settings.
